title: Mixing: Beautiful Boys by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

A mixing session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 10 October 1980.

This session saw the completion of Ono’s song ‘Beautiful Boys’, and involved the addition of sampled audio from Star Wars. The song had been recorded on 15 August and 19 September 1980.
